raw_segments.text: Within the hour, the miracle was of course known to the whole monastery, and many visitors
who had come for the Mass.
No one seemed more impressed by it than the monk who had come the day before from St.
Sylvester, from the little monastery of Obdorsk in the far north.
It was he who had been standing near Madame Holikov the previous day, and had asked Father
Zossima earnestly, referring to the healing of the Lady's daughter.
How can you presume to do such things?
